entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A young hero from Theros and new planeswalker, a master with the javelin who creates magical shards of mirror-glass that trap allies or adversaries.

events.summary: Niko, born to a destiny they never chose, escapes to follow their own path through the Multiverse.
events.quote: Born to a destiny they never chose, they escaped to follow their own path through the Multiverse.
